motion.name: current-drift

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Square project filter with count and clear selected state.
components.css: .ds-filter-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 10px 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgba(164,214,225,.38)); border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--muted, #86aab5); font: 400 11px/1.4 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s, color .2s, border-color .2s; } .ds-filter-chip span { color: var(--cyan, #54cede); font: 500 9px/1 monospace; } .ds-filter-chip:hover, .ds-filter-chip:focus-visible, .ds-filter-chip[aria-pressed=true] { background: var(--panel-hi, #0b3d50); border-color: var(--cyan, #54cede); color: var(--ice, #e8f7f8); } .ds-filter-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #54cede); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Editorial header navigation with thin separators and restrained hover fill.
components.html: WorkAbout
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: stretch; background: var(--deep, #041d2a); } .ds-nav a { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 0 19px; border-left: 1px solid var(--line, rgba(164,214,225,.18)); color: var(--muted, #86aab5); font: 400 12px/1.4 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: color .2s, background .2s; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current=page] { color: var(--ice, #e8f7f8); background: rgba(83,206,222,.06); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #54cede); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Project Artwork Frame
components.description: Rectangular abstract illustration frame for a portfolio project.
components.css: .ds-project-art { position: relative; display: grid; place-items: center; aspect-ratio: 1.6 / 1; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgba(164,214,225,.38)); border-radius: 0; background: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 55%, #125269, var(--panel, #082f40) 63%, var(--ocean, #062838)); } .ds-project-art::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background-image: linear-gradient(rgba(134,200,211,.035) 1px, transparent 1px), linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(134,200,211,.035) 1px, transparent 1px); background-size: 44px 44px; } .ds-orbit { position: absolute; width: 54%; height: 74%; border: 1px solid rgba(119,222,232,.48); border-radius: 50%; transform: rotate(-30deg); } .ds-core { z-index: 1; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 64px; height: 64px; border-radius: 50%; background: #b8e8e9; color: #0a3341; font: 800 28px/1 'Barlow Condensed', Impact, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 0 38px rgba(71,217,229,.34); }

components.name: Editorial Text Link
components.description: Compact uppercase call to action with a cyan arrow and visible keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-text-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; color: var(--ice, #e8f7f8); font: 700 10px/1.4 'DM Sans', Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .14em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-text-link span { color: var(--cyan, #54cede); font-size: 17px; transition: transform .2s; } .ds-text-link:hover span { transform: translateX(4px); } .ds-text-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--cyan, #54cede); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
This is an editorial portfolio set in a deep ocean palette. A fine coordinate grid, precise rules, oversized condensed typography, and flowing current lines give the work a sense of motion while keeping the reading structure calm. The visual language takes cues from wodniack.dev, then expresses them through Aman's own identity, writing, and abstract artwork.

The interface is a frame for projects and research: high contrast headlines establish hierarchy; DM Sans keeps details clear; Georgia adds an editorial voice to introductions and longer passages. Project art is drawn with SVG and CSS as abstract diagrams. It is illustrative, not a screenshot or a claim about a model's output.
keyCharacteristics: Dark ocean blues, icy text, and restrained cyan accents.
Large Barlow Condensed display type balanced by readable DM Sans and Georgia.
Thin grid and section rules with generous editorial spacing.
Flowing SVG current artwork and abstract project diagrams.

rules.name: The Signal Color Rule
rules.body: Cyan marks a state, path, or point of attention; it does not become a large decorative fill.

rules.name: The Three-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Barlow Condensed for hierarchy, DM Sans for utility and reading, and Georgia for editorial emphasis; do not add a fourth display voice.

dos: Do keep the deep ocean field, icy text, and restrained cyan as the recurring color relationship.
Do build new project art from abstract SVG or CSS diagrams that represent the subject.
Do use the typed portfolio content as the source of project labels and facts.
Do preserve reduced-motion behavior, keyboard focus, and the public contact address amancodinghere@gmail.com.
donts: Don't add product screenshots or model-output imagery; the visual system uses abstract authored illustrations.
Don't reintroduce the private CV email or add another public email address.
Don't add source or deployment links for Job Advertisement Information Extraction or Toohak; those destinations are no longer available to share.
Don't replace the fine rules and square frames with rounded cards, pills, or generic shadow-heavy panels.
Don't remove the reduced-motion treatment or rely on animation to convey essential information.
